rules.title: Allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For a covered San Francisco rent-controlled unit, your landlord's annual rent increase between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027 may not exceed 1.6%. Check that any increase you receive is within this limit.
rules.key_value: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 (1.4% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026; 1.7% for March 1, 2024 – February 28, 2025)

coverage.summary: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance; this rate page does not describe which units are covered.

rules.title: Security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Your landlord must pay interest on your security deposit at 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027. Ask for this interest if it has not been paid.
rules.key_value: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 (5.0% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026; 5.2% for March 1, 2024 – February 28, 2025)

coverage.summary: Security deposits on San Francisco rental units; this rate page does not describe coverage.

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition, removal, capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: If you are evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work (20+ days), or substantial rehabilitation with a notice served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, you are owed $8,245 per tenant (up to $24,733 per unit), plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant, max $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children (3/01/26 – 2/28/27); $8,062.00 / $24,184.00 / $5,375.00 (3/01/25 – 2/28/26)

coverage.summary: Tenants of San Francisco units evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 instead.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction: Displacements under 20 days for capital improvements are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not § 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: If you are evicted under the Ellis Act with a notice served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, you are owed $11,110.05 per tenant (up to $33,330.13 per unit), plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.

coverage.summary: Tenants of San Francisco units evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market).

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement under 20 days
rules.requirement: If you are temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days with a notice served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, your household is owed $446 per day plus actual moving expenses.

coverage.summary: San Francisco tenant households temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: Applies instead of S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9C for displacements under 20 days.

notes: Rate table page from SF Rent Board. Citations for rent increase (§ 37.3) and deposit interest (ch. 49) are not stated on the page and come from the governing ordinance; coverage cutoffs are not stated here, so left null. Rent Board fee, capital improvement interest and labor rates are out of scope.
